# awscc_mgn_application (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::MGN::Application



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `application_id` (String) The ID of the application.
- `arn` (String) The ARN of the application.
- `creation_date_time` (String) The date and time the application was created.
- `description` (String) The description of the application.
- `is_archived` (Boolean) Whether the application is archived.
- `last_modified_date_time` (String) The date and time the application was last modified.
- `name` (String) The name of the application.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) A set of tags to associate with the application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:
